Subject: Renewal QBR — modular demo blocks & ring-fenced scheduling

Hi Lara —

Thanks again for the heads-up on Clearline's renewal cadence. Rather than a single 90-minute walkthrough, we wanted to propose a modular approach that keeps exec time tight while ring-fencing deeper technical time for your infra and data teams. The two options attached outline: a 30-minute exec-focused slate + two 30-minute deep-dive blocks (tech + integration), or a single 75–90 minute compact demo with built-in QA.

High-level ask: can you confirm whether your execs prefer a strict 30-minute slot (option A) or the compact 75-minute slot (option B)? If A, we can reserve two adjacent 30-minute technical blocks for your engineers; those can be held as "standby" until the exec slot completes and we confirm attendees.

Proposed tentative windows (PST):
- Option A (modular): Exec 11:00–11:30 (PST), Tech deep-dive 11:40–12:10, Integration 12:20–12:50
- Option B (compact): 11:00–12:15 (PST) full demo + Q&A

We can also offer a 15-minute pre-brief with the Clearline SRE/infra leads the day before if you want a dry run. Ben, can you confirm host/technical ownership if we go modular?

Attached: QBR_demo_block_map_v1.pdf, proposed_agenda_30min_and_90min.docx

Thanks — Naomi
